body.summary: A long-running web serial (on QuestionableQuesting and later its own site) built around a litRPG premise: the protagonist, a young woman, gains a video-game-style interface that quantifies her life, including an explicit 'Erogame' stat system tracking arousal, experience and unlockable perks. The story follows her as she learns to exploit and is exploited by the system, with sexual encounters framed as leveling mechanics, and expands into a wider conspiracy about other players and the origin of the game layer. I know the premise and its reputation for explicit content and meta game-mechanics, but not the plot's later turns or ending with confidence, so I have kept specifics sparse.
